name: neogreennexus
description: Ecosistema Modular NeoGreenNexus (Web, Android APK & Nexus Core Desktop)

scripts.desktop:build: electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish always && powershell -Command "if (Test-Path dist-desktop) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist-desktop -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
scripts.android:build: npx cap copy android && .\android\gradlew -p android assembleDebug && node scripts/upload-apk.js
scripts.deploy:all: npm run version:bump && npm run git:push && npm run desktop:build && npm run android:build && firebase deploy --only hosting
